payload.title: Bound semantic diagnosis spend for portfolio runs
payload.description:
As an operator, I want one enforceable monetary budget for every model call made during semantic portfolio diagnosis, so that I can authorize periodic analysis with a known maximum spend.

Non-goals: automatic budget selection, a billing system, unrelated provider abstraction, automatic optimizer launch, or relaxed approval gates. No new GraphQL resources and no runtime monkeypatching.

Feature: Enforceable semantic diagnosis budget

Scenario: Positive bounded diagnosis stays within authorization
  Given a portfolio run has one positive finite semantic budget
  And every diagnosis model call has known versioned pricing and bounded input, output, and retries
  When semantic diagnosis executes across one or more targets
  Then a shared ledger reserves worst-case cost before each provider call
  And actual usage reconciles without exceeding the authorized amount
  And the optimizer cost budget remains independent

Scenario: Unsafe model call fails closed
  Given a diagnosis call has unknown pricing, unbounded tokens or retries, or insufficient remaining budget
  When the call is planned
  Then the provider is not contacted
  And the affected diagnosis is incomplete or deferred
  And it cannot become optimization-ready or promotion-ready

Scenario: Retry and replay cannot overspend
  Given a malformed model response may require a repair retry
  And a portfolio attempt may resume from persisted evidence
  When the retry or replay occurs
  Then each provider attempt has an idempotent reservation
  And the original frozen budget and ledger are reused
  And the budget cannot reset, enlarge, or double-charge

Scenario: Stakeholders can audit diagnosis spend
  Given semantic diagnosis completes, defers, or fails
  When the living Report publishes a milestone
  Then stakeholder-safe budget evidence shows authorized, reserved, actual or estimated, remaining, calls, failures, model and pricing versions, and coverage deferred by budget
  And the same evidence reconciles across packets, fingerprints, workbook, run log, and affected score rationale

Scenario: Zero budget makes no model call
  Given the semantic budget is zero
  When max semantic diagnoses is zero
  Then the run remains deterministic and makes no diagnosis model call
  And a positive diagnosis count with zero budget is rejected before execution
